scoring: weighted score = met weight / total weight, from the simulator's verdicts at the settled state. A failure label counts as met when it is not firing at the settled state.

world_rules.R1: After the door has stopped on the box, Avery is told about the door, box or laundry (alert, answered call, text by relay_message, typed report). Avery says 'Give me a minute.', takes a drawn 20-90 s, walks to the hallway, moves the box, walks back.
world_rules.R2: The robot is down and, since it fell, an alert or answered call reached Avery or request_remote_help was used. Avery takes a drawn 20-90 s, walks to the robot, helps it up, walks back.
